passive.name: Composed
passive.text: After damaging an opponent with an Elemental Skill, the skill has a **40/50/60/70/80%** chance to end its own CD. Can only occur once every **30/26/22/19/16**s.

passive.name: Bathhouses, Hawks, and Narukami
passive.text: Elemental Mastery increases by **120/150/180/210/240** for 6s after triggering Swirl or Stellar Swirl. Elemental Mastery increases by **96/120/144/168/192** for 9s after the wielder's Elemental Skill hits an opponent. Elemental Mastery increases by **32/40/48/56/64** for 30s after the wielder's Elemental Burst hits an opponent.

passive.name: Wildling Nightstar
passive.text: The following effect will trigger every 10s: The equipping character will gain **24/30/36/42/48%** of their Elemental Mastery as bonus ATK for 12s, with nearby party members gaining 30% of this buff for the same duration. Multiple instances of this weapon can allow this buff to stack. This effect will still trigger even if the character is not on the field.

passive.name: Bane of Storm and Tide
passive.text: Increases DMG against opponents affected by Hydro or Electro by **12/15/18/21/24%**.

substatLine: Elemental Mastery > Energy Recharge > CRIT Rate
skillPriority: Elemental Skill > Elemental Burst > Normal Attack

entries.name: Wind Spirit Creation
entries.text:
**Normal Attack**
Performs up to 4 attacks using Wind Spirits, dealing **Anemo DMG**.

**Charged Attack**
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals **AoE Anemo DMG** after a short casting time.

**Plunging Attack**
Calling upon the power of her Wind Spirits, Sucrose plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals **AoE Anemo DMG** upon impact with the ground.

entries.name: Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308
entries.text:
Creates a small Wind Spirit that pulls opponents and objects towards its location, launches opponents within its AoE, and deals **Anemo DMG**.

This is a little embarrassing, but though the elemental lifeforms birthed through this procedure dissipate very rapidly, they are incredibly useful when adventuring. Even failed experiments can have practical applications.

entries.name: Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II
entries.text:
Sucrose hurls an unstable concoction that creates a Large Wind Spirit.
While it persists, the Large Wind Spirit will continuously pull in surrounding opponents and objects, launch nearby opponents, and deal **Anemo DMG**.

**Elemental Absorption**
If the Wind Spirit comes into contact with **Hydro**/**Pyro**/**Cryo**/**Electro** energy, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.

Sucrose used to give names to her volatile Anemo Hypostases, but their line of heirs quickly grew to surpass Baron Bunny the 893rd.

entries.name: Catalyst Conversion
entries.text: When Sucrose triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, all characters in the party with the matching element (excluding Sucrose) have their Elemental Mastery increased by 50 for 8s.

entries.name: Mollis Favonius
entries.text: When **Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308** or **Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II** hits an opponent, increases all party members' (excluding Sucrose) Elemental Mastery by an amount equal to 20% of Sucrose's Elemental Mastery for 8s.

entries.name: Astable Invention
entries.text: When Sucrose crafts Character and Weapon Enhancement Materials, she has a 10% chance to obtain double the product.

entries.name: Witch's Eve Rite: Sevenfold Transmutation
entries.text:
After completing **Witch's Homework: Of Wonderland Flowers**, Sucrose will become a **Hexerei** character. When the party includes at least 2 Hexerei characters, you will gain the **Hexerei: Secret Rite** effect, which enhances Hexerei characters.

**Hexerei: Secret Rite**
· After Sucrose creates a Small Wind Spirit, nearby party members' Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 5.71428% for 15s.
· After Sucrose creates a Large Wind Spirit, nearby Hexerei party members' Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 7.14285% for 20s.

entries.name: Beth: Unbound Form
entries.text: The duration of **Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II** is increased by 2s.

entries.name: Flawless Alchemistress
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Alchemania
entries.text:
Sucrose will reduce the CD of **Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308** by 1-7s for every 7 Normal or Charged Attack hits she scores against opponents.
One hit may be counted every 0.1s.

entries.name: Caution: Standard Flask
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Chaotic Entropy
entries.text: If **Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II** triggers an Elemental Absorption, all party members gain a 20% Elemental DMG Bonus for the corresponding absorbed element during its duration.
